# Tool reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_tool_reference.py from the registered MCP tools. Do not edit by hand. -->

`ha-safe-mcp` registers **133 tools**. All of them are always listed; the permission check runs
when a tool is called. *Level* is the permission class, *Switches* the server settings it needs in addition
to a Home Assistant token whose user is allowed to do the same thing in Home Assistant. `?` marks an
optional parameter. Full JSON schemas: call `tools/list` on the server.

## States and actions

| Tool | Level | Switches | Parameters | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ha_search_entities` | read | none | `query`?: string, `domain`?: string, `limit`?: integer | Search current entity IDs and friendly names, optionally filter by domain. |
| `ha_get_state` | read | none | `entity_id`: string | Read the current state and attributes of one entity. |
| `ha_list_services` | read | none | `domain`?: string | List action names for a domain; filter by domain to save context. |
| `ha_call_service` | control | `HA_ALLOW_WRITE` | `domain`: string, `service`: string, `entity_id`: string/array, `service_data`?: object/null, `return_response`?: boolean | Call an action (e.g. light.turn_on) for one entity_id or a list of up to 20 entity_ids of the same domain (e.g. all available lights of a room from ha_list_area_entities). Returns states_after: the targets read back after the call with confirmed true/false (false = expected state not reached; report that, do not claim success). return_response=true returns the data of services that answer (e.g. todo.get_items). Disabled unless HA_ALLOW_WRITE=true; only configured domains allowed. |

## Documented REST API

| Tool | Level | Switches | Parameters | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ha_rest_catalog` | read | none | none | Discover the documented REST routes and their permission classes. |
| `ha_rest_query` | read | none | `path`: string, `query`?: object/null, `method`?: string, `body`?: object/null | Call a documented GET route or the safe POST template/config-check routes. |
| `ha_rest_write` | control/admin | per route, see `ha_rest_catalog` | `path`: string, `body`?: object/null, `query`?: object/null | POST a documented mutation. Requires HA_ALLOW_WRITE; admin routes need HA_ALLOW_ADMIN_WRITE. |
| `ha_rest_delete` | delete | `HA_ALLOW_WRITE` + `HA_ALLOW_ADMIN_WRITE` + `HA_ALLOW_DELETE` | `path`: string | DELETE a documented state route. Requires HA_ALLOW_WRITE, HA_ALLOW_ADMIN_WRITE and HA_ALLOW_DELETE. |

## Automations

| Tool | Level | Switches | Parameters | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ha_validate_automation` | read | none | `config`: object | Ask Home Assistant to validate automation triggers, conditions and actions; no write. |
| `ha_get_automation` | read | none | `config_id`: string | Read an automation's raw config by its configuration ID. |
| `ha_save_automation` | admin | `HA_ALLOW_WRITE` + `HA_ALLOW_ADMIN_WRITE` | `config_id`: string, `config`: object | Validate, create/update and read back automation config. Requires admin write opt-in. |

## Helpers

| Tool | Level | Switches | Parameters | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ha_list_helpers` | read | none | `domain`: string | List storage helpers of one domain: input_boolean, input_number, input_select, input_text, input_datetime, input_button, counter, timer, schedule. Config-flow helpers: ha_list_helper_types. |
| `ha_create_helper` | admin | `HA_ALLOW_WRITE` + `HA_ALLOW_ADMIN_WRITE` | `domain`: string, `config`: object | Create a storage helper and verify it appears in the list. domain and config: input_boolean {name}, input_number {name, min, max, step?, mode?}, input_select {name, options}, input_text {name}, input_datetime {name, has_date, has_time}, input_button {name}, counter {name, initial?, step?, minimum?, maximum?}, timer {name, duration 'HH:MM:SS'}, schedule {name, monday..sunday: [{from, to}]}; icon optional. Template, group, utility meter and other helpers are config flows (ha_list_helper_types). Admin write required. |
| `ha_list_helper_types` | read | none | none | Which helper types exist and how to create them: storage helpers (ha_create_helper) and config-flow helpers such as template, group, utility_meter, derivative, threshold, tod (setup flow), plus the existing config-flow helpers with entry_id. |
| `ha_update_helper` | admin | `HA_ALLOW_WRITE` + `HA_ALLOW_ADMIN_WRITE` | `domain`: string, `helper_id`: string, `config`: object | Update a storage helper by collection ID and read back. Admin write required. |
| `ha_delete_helper` | delete | `HA_ALLOW_WRITE` + `HA_ALLOW_ADMIN_WRITE` + `HA_ALLOW_DELETE` | `domain`: string, `helper_id`: string | Delete a storage helper by collection ID; requires admin write and delete opt-ins. |

## Entity registry

| Tool | Level | Switches | Parameters | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ha_list_entity_registry` | read | none | none | List registry entries for integration-managed entities; does not create entities. |
| `ha_get_entity_registry` | read | none | `entity_id`: string | One entity's registry entry: name, icon, area, labels, categories, aliases (voice assistant names), disabled/hidden state, platform. Entities without a unique ID are not in the registry. |
| `ha_update_entity_registry` | admin | `HA_ALLOW_WRITE` + `HA_ALLOW_ADMIN_WRITE` | `entity_id`: string, `changes`: object | Edit an entity's registry entry; does not create entities. changes may contain: name (null = name from the integration), icon, area_id (null = follow the device), aliases (complete list of names for voice assistants; a null entry stands for the entity's own name, keep it), labels (complete list of label_ids), categories ({scope: category_id or null}, e.g. {"automation": "<id>"} to file an automation), disabled_by / hidden_by ('user' or null). Admin write required. To change the entity_id use ha_rename_entity. |

## Areas, floors, devices

| Tool | Level | Switches | Parameters | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ha_list_zigbee_devices` | read | none | `problems_only`?: boolean | Zigbee (ZHA) devices with availability, link quality (lqi), rssi, last seen and role; counts of unavailable and weak devices. problems_only=true lists only those. No device addresses. |
| `ha_list_areas` | read | none | none | List areas (rooms) with area_id, name, floor_id, icon and aliases. |
| `ha_list_floors` | read | none | none | List floors with floor_id, name and level. |
| `ha_list_area_entities` | read | none | `area`: string, `domain`?: string | Entities of one room: area may be the area_id, its name or an alias (e.g. 'Wohnzimmer'). Follows the device's area like HA does. Returns available/unavailable entity_ids, the entities with state, and groups whose members are in the room. Optional domain filter, e.g. 'light'. |
| `ha_list_devices` | read | none | `area_id`?: string, `query`?: string, `limit`?: integer | List devices with device_id, name, manufacturer, model and area_id. Filter by area_id, or area_id='none' for devices without an area; query matches name/manufacturer/model. |
| `ha_create_area` | admin | `HA_ALLOW_WRITE` + `HA_ALLOW_ADMIN_WRITE` | `name`: string, `floor_id`?: string/null, `icon`?: string/null | Create an area (room), e.g. name 'Flur', icon 'mdi:door'; returns its area_id. Admin write required. |
| `ha_update_area` | admin | `HA_ALLOW_WRITE` + `HA_ALLOW_ADMIN_WRITE` | `area_id`: string, `changes`: object | Change an area's name, floor_id, icon or aliases and read back. Admin write required. |
| `ha_delete_area` | delete | `HA_ALLOW_WRITE` + `HA_ALLOW_ADMIN_WRITE` + `HA_ALLOW_DELETE` | `area_id`: string | Delete an area; its devices and entities stay and lose the area. Admin write and delete required. |
| `ha_create_floor` | admin | `HA_ALLOW_WRITE` + `HA_ALLOW_ADMIN_WRITE` | `name`: string, `level`?: integer/null, `icon`?: string/null | Create a floor, e.g. name 'Erdgeschoss', level 0. Admin write required. |
| `ha_update_floor` | admin | `HA_ALLOW_WRITE` + `HA_ALLOW_ADMIN_WRITE` | `floor_id`: string, `changes`: object | Change a floor's name, level, icon or aliases and read back. Admin write required. |
| `ha_delete_floor` | delete | `HA_ALLOW_WRITE` + `HA_ALLOW_ADMIN_WRITE` + `HA_ALLOW_DELETE` | `floor_id`: string | Delete a floor; its areas stay without floor. Admin write and delete required. |
| `ha_update_device` | admin | `HA_ALLOW_WRITE` + `HA_ALLOW_ADMIN_WRITE` | `device_id`: string, `changes`: object | Assign a device to an area or rename/disable it: changes may contain area_id (or null), name_by_user (or null to reset), disabled_by ('user' or null), labels. Admin write required. Removing devices is not offered (delete the integration instead). |

## Scenes and scripts

| Tool | Level | Switches | Parameters | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ha_list_scenes` | read | none | none | List scenes with entity_id, name, scene_id (editable when set) and the entities they control. |
| `ha_get_scene` | read | none | `scene_id`: string | Read a UI scene's stored config (name, entities with target states). |
| `ha_save_scene` | admin | `HA_ALLOW_WRITE` + `HA_ALLOW_ADMIN_WRITE` | `scene_id`: string, `config`: object | Create or replace a scene: config {"name": "Abendlicht", "entities": {"light.flur": {"state": "on", "brightness": 120}}}. Use real entity_ids from ha_search_entities. Returns previous config for rollback. Admin write required. |
| `ha_delete_scene` | delete | `HA_ALLOW_WRITE` + `HA_ALLOW_ADMIN_WRITE` + `HA_ALLOW_DELETE` | `scene_id`: string | Delete a UI scene by scene_id. Admin write and delete required. |
| `ha_activate_scene` | control | `HA_ALLOW_WRITE` | `entity_id`: string | Activate a scene (scene.turn_on), e.g. entity_id 'scene.abendlicht'. Needs write and 'scene' in the allowed domains. |
| `ha_list_scripts` | read | none | none | List scripts with entity_id, name, script_id, running state and last run. |
| `ha_get_script` | read | none | `script_id`: string | Read a UI script's stored config (alias, sequence, mode, ...). |
| `ha_save_script` | admin | `HA_ALLOW_WRITE` + `HA_ALLOW_ADMIN_WRITE` | `script_id`: string, `config`: object | Create or replace a script: config {"alias": "Gute Nacht", "sequence": [{"action": "light.turn_off", "target": {"entity_id": "light.flur"}}], "mode": "single"}. HA validates the sequence first. Returns previous config for rollback. Admin write required. |
| `ha_delete_script` | delete | `HA_ALLOW_WRITE` + `HA_ALLOW_ADMIN_WRITE` + `HA_ALLOW_DELETE` | `script_id`: string | Delete a UI script by script_id. Admin write and delete required. |
| `ha_run_script` | control | `HA_ALLOW_WRITE` | `entity_id`: string | Start a script (script.turn_on), e.g. 'script.gute_nacht'. Needs write and 'script' in the allowed domains. |

## Backups

| Tool | Level | Switches | Parameters | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ha_list_backups` | read | none | none | List Home Assistant backups (newest first) with backup_id, name, date, size and storage agents. |
| `ha_create_backup` | admin | `HA_ALLOW_WRITE` + `HA_ALLOW_ADMIN_WRITE` | `name`: string, `password`?: object/null | Create a full backup (configuration + database) on the local backup agent and wait until it is listed. ## Integrations and credentials

| Tool | Level | Switches | Parameters | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ha_list_integrations` | read | none | `domain`?: string | List configured integrations (config entries) with entry_id, domain, title and state. |
| `ha_list_integration_types` | read | none | `query`?: string | List integration domains that can be set up through the UI flow, filtered by query (e.g. 'shelly'). |
| `ha_list_discovered` | read | none | none | List devices Home Assistant itself discovered on its network (zeroconf/dhcp/ssdp/...) that wait for confirmation. This tool does not scan the network; an empty list means HA found nothing. |
| `ha_list_credentials` | read | none | none | List stored credential aliases and their field names (never values) for setup steps. |
| `ha_start_integration_setup` | admin | `HA_ALLOW_WRITE` + `HA_ALLOW_ADMIN_WRITE` | `handler`: string, `show_advanced_options`?: boolean | Start adding an integration (e.g. handler 'shelly') or a config-flow helper (e.g. 'template', 'group', 'utility_meter', 'derivative'; see ha_list_helper_types); returns the first form (data_schema) or a menu (menu_options) with a flow_id. Admin write required. |
| `ha_integration_setup_step` | admin | `HA_ALLOW_WRITE` + `HA_ALLOW_ADMIN_WRITE` | `flow_id`: string, `data`?: object/null | Submit one form step of a setup flow, field names from data_schema; keep shown defaults unless the user said otherwise. Secret fields (password, token, api_key, pin) must be credential references: {"$credential": "<alias>", "field": "<field>"} from ha_list_credentials; plain secret values are rejected. For discovered devices send {} to confirm. For a menu (type 'menu') send {"next_step_id": "<one of menu_options>"}. If the setup cannot be finished, call ha_abort_integration_setup. A created entry is journaled (undo removes it). Admin write required. |
| `ha_abort_integration_setup` | admin | `HA_ALLOW_WRITE` + `HA_ALLOW_ADMIN_WRITE` | `flow_id`: string | Abort a running setup flow. Admin write required. |
| `ha_start_integration_options` | admin | `HA_ALLOW_WRITE` + `HA_ALLOW_ADMIN_WRITE` | `entry_id`: string, `show_advanced_options`?: boolean | Open the settings (options) of a configured integration whose supports_options is true; returns a form with current values as defaults and a flow_id. Admin write required. |
| `ha_integration_options_step` | admin | `HA_ALLOW_WRITE` + `HA_ALLOW_ADMIN_WRITE` | `flow_id`: string, `data`?: object/null | Submit one options form step; keep shown defaults unless the user wants them changed. Secret fields only as credential references. Admin write required. |
| `ha_abort_integration_options` | admin | `HA_ALLOW_WRITE` + `HA_ALLOW_ADMIN_WRITE` | `flow_id`: string | Abort an options flow without saving. Admin write required. |
| `ha_start_integration_reconfigure` | admin | `HA_ALLOW_WRITE` + `HA_ALLOW_ADMIN_WRITE` | `entry_id`: string, `show_advanced_options`?: boolean | Reconfigure the connection of an integration whose supports_reconfigure is true (e.g. new host/IP); continue with ha_integration_setup_step. Admin write required. |
| `ha_update_integration` | admin | `HA_ALLOW_WRITE` + `HA_ALLOW_ADMIN_WRITE` | `entry_id`: string, `changes`: object | Rename an integration entry or change its system options: changes may contain title, pref_disable_polling, pref_disable_new_entities. Admin write required. |
| `ha_set_integration_disabled` | admin | `HA_ALLOW_WRITE` + `HA_ALLOW_ADMIN_WRITE` | `entry_id`: string, `disabled`: boolean | Disable (true) or re-enable (false) an integration entry; its entities become unavailable while disabled. Admin write required. |
| `ha_reload_integration` | admin | `HA_ALLOW_WRITE` + `HA_ALLOW_ADMIN_WRITE` | `entry_id`: string | Reload a configured integration by entry_id. Admin write required. |
| `ha_delete_integration` | delete | `HA_ALLOW_WRITE` + `HA_ALLOW_ADMIN_WRITE` + `HA_ALLOW_DELETE` | `entry_id`: string | Remove a configured integration and its devices by entry_id. Admin write and delete required. |

| `ha_list_config_files` | read | none | `path`?: string | List a folder of the Home Assistant config directory ('' = top level, e.g. 'packages'): files with size and whether they can be read, sub-folders. Hidden folders (.storage) are not shown. |

| `ha_edit_config_file` | admin | `HA_ALLOW_WRITE` + `HA_ALLOW_ADMIN_WRITE` | `path`: string, `old_text`: string, `new_text`: string, `replace_all`?: boolean | Replace old_text (copied exactly from ha_read_config_file, unique unless replace_all) with new_text in a config file. YAML is syntax-checked and HA's config check runs; a change that adds errors is reverted. Journaled (undo with ha_undo_change). Not active until ha_reload or ha_restart. Admin write required. |
| `ha_write_config_file` | admin | `HA_ALLOW_WRITE` + `HA_ALLOW_ADMIN_WRITE` | `path`: string, `content`: string | Create a config file or replace its whole content (e.g. a new package 'packages/x.yaml'; packages need 'homeassistant: packages: !include_dir_named packages' in configuration.yaml). Keep __REDACTED_n__ placeholders; new credentials go into secrets.yaml (by the user) and are referenced with !secret. Same checks, journal and activation as ha_edit_config_file. Admin write required. |
| `ha_delete_config_file` | delete | `HA_ALLOW_WRITE` + `HA_ALLOW_ADMIN_WRITE` + `HA_ALLOW_DELETE` | `path`: string | Delete a config file (journaled, undo restores it). Admin write and delete required. |
| `ha_list_addons` | read | none | none | Installed add-ons (Supervisor installs) with state (started/stopped), version and pending updates; empty without a Supervisor. |

| `ha_list_thread_networks` | read | none | none | Thread networks known to Home Assistant (name, channel, preferred, source). No network keys or IDs. |

For a question about one day pass day='today', 'tomorrow' or 'YYYY-MM-DD'. Read-only. |
